title: 2008 AMC 8 Problem 4
statement: In the figure, the outer equilateral triangle has area \(16,\) the inner equilateral triangle has area \(1,\) and the three trapezoids are congruent. What is the area of one of the trapezoids?

solutions.text:
The outer triangle has area \(16\), and the inner triangle has area \(1\).

So the three congruent trapezoids have total area \(16-1=15\), and each trapezoid has area \(15\div3=5\).

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Subtract the inner triangle area from the outer triangle area.
The remaining area is split equally among the three congruent trapezoids.
